description: Per-class axis-aligned BEV NMS IoU=0.5 on NMSFreeCoder. Within noise of baseline.
Per-class BEV NMS IoU=0.2 (aggressive). mAP -0.36% vs baseline. NMS harmful for set-based DETR.
Increase max_num from 300 to 500. mAP +0.11% (noise). topk not a bottleneck.

Average logits over last 3 decoder layers. mAP -0.18%. Earlier layers dilute quality.
Average logits over all 6 decoder layers. mAP -0.34%. Worse with more layers.
Avg boxes over last 3 decoder layers, last layer scores. Neutral.
Avg boxes over last 2 decoder layers, last layer scores. Neutral.
Zero velocity for barrier+traffic_cone. Model already predicts ~0 for these. No effect.
CLAHE (clip=2.0) on all images before inference. Zero effect. ResNet features robust to contrast changes.
H9.1 DINOv3 reclassification (thresh=0.15, min_sim=0.3): 2617 reclass, mAP -6.82%. Mostly wrong reclassifications (car->traffic_cone). DINOv3 crop classification unreliable on small objects.
H9.2/H9.3 DINOv3 sweep: FP filter hurts (removes TPs), score fusion neutral. No strategy improves over baseline. DINOv3 crop features not useful for post-processing.
